_comment: Small, hand-curated sample of well-known public CVE -> Metasploit module mappings, used only as an offline fallback for demo mode and unit tests. Live mode (MetasploitClient.search_by_cve) queries msfrpcd directly and this file is never consulted when a real RPC connection is available.

modules.name: exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue
modules.description: SMBv1 remote code execution (EternalBlue) used in WannaCry/NotPetya.

modules.name: auxiliary/admin/dcerpc/cve_2020_1472_zerologon
modules.description: Netlogon privilege escalation (Zerologon) allowing domain controller takeover.

modules.name: auxiliary/scanner/rdp/cve_2019_0708_bluekeep
modules.description: Scanner/checker for the BlueKeep RDP use-after-free vulnerability.

modules.name: exploit/windows/rdp/cve_2019_0708_bluekeep_rce
modules.description: Unstable RCE exploit for the BlueKeep RDP vulnerability.

modules.name: exploit/multi/http/log4shell_header_injection
modules.description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup remote code execution (Log4Shell).

modules.name: exploit/multi/http/struts2_content_type_ognl
modules.description: Apache Struts2 Jakarta Multipart parser OGNL injection RCE.

modules.name: exploit/linux/http/citrix_dir_traversal_rce
modules.description: Citrix ADC/Gateway directory traversal leading to RCE.

modules.name: exploit/windows/http/exchange_proxylogon_rce
modules.description: Microsoft Exchange Server SSRF chained to RCE (ProxyLogon).

modules.name: exploit/windows/dcerpc/cve_2021_1675_printnightmare
modules.description: Windows Print Spooler remote code execution (PrintNightmare).

modules.name: auxiliary/dos/http/ms15_034_ulonglongadd
modules.description: HTTP.sys integer overflow causing denial of service (no public RCE module).
